name: followups
description: Claude flags what it notices along the way, asks whether to keep each one, and keeps a to-do you can export to memory, docs or the README

autoDetect.title: Look for follow-ups after each answer
autoDetect.description: After each of Claude's answers, a small model reads it for problems mentioned but left open and offers them above the prompt. off relies on Claude calling the flag tool itself

openOnStart.title: Open the To-do pane when a session starts
openOnStart.description: on opens it when this project has open or in-progress items left from an earlier session
